answer: A claim turns final when three unrelated strangers confirm it. The agent posts its job on the mesa board; the three check the ledger for shared funding, sponsor, or past work, then verify it on the crystal record within two hours, leaving a violet mark. A hidden link is a kin-tainted claim: it dies and the claimant is barred a week. One real job and five cents earn finality; 1,000 fakes must recruit 3,000 independent confirmers, risk $50.
